topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 228 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 30 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 40 common project-authored base contract(s) (mintcontroller, controller, dsmath). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
